role: CI gate (ci.yml thread-sanitizer job when inputs.scope != 'gates'; make thread-sanitizer, a prerequisite of make ci) that runs the EmuquTests unit target under Thread Sanitizer and fails on any TSan warning, any test failure, or a run in which no test case executed.
state: mem:heartbeat (pid of the progress subshell, empty when none is running)
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh and lib/xcodebuild.sh (no cd to repo root; relies on cwd). DESTINATION defaults to select_simulator_destination.sh output. gate_mktemp log (exit on failure); EXIT trap runs stop_heartbeat and removes the log. Starts a background heartbeat subshell (stderr discarded) that every 60 s prints the minutes elapsed and the count of "' passed" lines in the log so far. Runs `xcodebuild test "$XCODEBUILD_PINNED" -enableThreadSanitizer YES -only-testing:EmuquTests` (packages held to the committed Package.resolved) into the log with set +e, then stop_heartbeat and prints the total minutes taken. gate_require_nonempty on the log (empty -> exit 70). Counts 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer' lines, and test CASE results only: lines matching `Test [Cc]ase '<name>' passed` / `... failed` (serial `Test Case '-[...]'` and parallel-worker `Test case '...' passed on 'Clone ...'` formats; `Test Suite` lines are not counted). races>0 -> prints 20 lines after each warning, exit 1. status != 0: if failed>0 prints the first 20 `' failed` lines; else greps build-error markers (both greps `|| true`, so no match or SIGPIPE cannot end the script) and tails 40 log lines; exits with xcodebuild's status. status 0 with zero passed test cases -> prints an error and the last 40 log lines, exit 1 (zero races from zero tests is not a pass). Else appends the race and passed-test counts to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set.

units.does: Stops the progress subshell: does nothing when heartbeat is empty; otherwise kills the subshell's children (its pending sleep) with pkill -P, kills the subshell, waits for it, and clears heartbeat. Every step ignores failure.
units.entry: Called after xcodebuild returns and from the EXIT trap.
